about.p1: We combine work that usually lives apart: electrical engineering, IoT, AI, manufacturing and content. The reason is simple: real projects rarely stay inside one discipline. An agricultural drone needs mechanics, firmware and a computer-vision model at the same time.
about.p2: Much of our work also feeds back into education. Ragnarok PLC trainers are used in vocational schools, the Labs sit inside SMK Negeri 4 Jakarta, and the Robotics Catalyst book is written for vocational students.

w.agrihex.approach: An Intel RealSense D435i depth camera and a Jetson Orin/Nano edge computer read crop condition from the air. ArduPilot handles flight, while data goes to a FastAPI-based cyber-physical cloud. The concept inherits RigRoom's Mecha FlyBot project.
w.agrihex.lede: A hexarotor drone that detects and sprays shallot crop disease in Nganjuk, East Java.
w.agrihex.m0.l: hexarotor for redundancy and spray payload
w.agrihex.m1.l: inference on Jetson, aggregation in CI-CPS
w.agrihex.problem: Shallot disease spreads fast and usually becomes visible only once it is widespread. Blanket spraying wastes pesticide on healthy areas.
w.armx.approach: Two iterations in one year. The results are used alongside Smart Room Monitor & Control, RigRoom's IoT system that reads environmental sensors and switches relays from an MQTT dashboard.
w.armx.lede: A self-built, servo-driven robotic arm. V1 proved the concept; Pro V1 raised payload and precision and added sensor feedback.
w.armx.problem: Industrial robotic arms are too expensive for learning and experimenting at small-lab scale.
w.audio.lede: The Last Z channel with Eurekanion for Hardstyle, Hardcore and Uptempo, following two rawstyle mixtapes: Death Impact 001 on YouTube and Relentless on SoundCloud.
w.audio.title: Last Z & rawstyle mixtapes
w.bst-avl.approach: BST and AVL implemented in C++, tested from 100 to 5,000 players with random and sorted input, measuring build time, tree height and 1,000 searches. Everything ran on one laptop, and the paper states that limitation plainly.
w.bst-avl.kicker: Publication · Jurnal Teknologi dan Open Source, 2026
w.bst-avl.lede: A C++ leaderboard stress test: a plain Binary Search Tree against an AVL Tree. With random data the BST wins. With already-sorted scores, the BST collapses into a linked list.
w.bst-avl.m0.l: slower: BST 1.1 s vs AVL 35 ms (5,000 players, sorted input)
w.bst-avl.m3.l: faster tree building for BST on random data
w.bst-avl.problem: Game leaderboards often receive scores that are almost sorted. A data structure that looks fast on random benchmarks can behave completely differently on real data.
w.bst-avl.title: BST vs AVL under pressure
w.catalyst.approach: Part One covers mechatronics fundamentals through automation. Part Two is planned for autonomous navigation, swarm robotics and Industry 4.0.
w.catalyst.lede: Human Catalyst, on the human role in technological change, and Robotics Catalyst Part One, a robotics reference book for vocational and polytechnic students.
w.catalyst.problem: Indonesian-language robotics books that go from mechatronics basics to modern automation are still rare.
w.catalyst.title: The Catalyst book series
w.gif-pdf.approach: Research first, then build. The prediction was that Chrome would fail, and tests in a Windows lab confirmed it. A page-level JavaScript trigger fixed Chrome; Firefox 157, PDF.js 6.3 and Edge also played the animation. Duplicate embedded fonts were removed without changing a single pixel.
w.gif-pdf.lede: Step-by-step automata animations that actually play inside a PDF, and as GIFs in Word documents. Tested in a Windows lab, not assumed.
w.gif-pdf.m0.l: PDF size after font deduplication, pixel-identical output
w.gif-pdf.problem: Automata course material is easier to follow when every transition visibly moves. The catch: most PDF viewers do not play animation, and Chrome's built-in viewer is one of them.
w.gif-pdf.title: Animations that play inside a PDF
w.mulya-jaya.approach: Acrylic CNC milling for shape and engraving, with FDM 3D printing joining the workflow in 2024. Each year the line grew, with tighter tolerances and new material options.
w.mulya-jaya.lede: A CNC and 3D-printing production line for schools, companies and formal events. It started with a single plaque order in 2022.
w.mulya-jaya.problem: Institutions need custom plaques and trophies in volume, on short deadlines, with a clean finish.
w.mulya-jaya.title: Acrylic plaques, medals & trophies
w.ragnarok-trainer.approach: A Mitsubishi trainer for pneumatics; a Siemens S7-1200 with diagnostics and a simple HMI; a Schneider with a dual-actuator pneumatic and hydraulic system; and a rebuild of a Yalong YL-1B unit with new wiring, sensor feedback and fresh technical documentation.
w.ragnarok-trainer.lede: Four industrial-control training units for vocational schools and polytechnics: three PLC brands and one industrial-miniature rebuild.
w.ragnarok-trainer.problem: Vocational students need the same equipment they will meet on the factory floor, not an on-screen simulation.
w.seratus-ilmu.approach: The UI/UX was modernised mobile-first. The project became NuRichter's first strategic partnership in professional training.
w.seratus-ilmu.kicker: Website rebuild · PT Karya Nusatama Indonesia
w.seratus-ilmu.lede: A rebuild of the Seratus Ilmu training platform's website, plus contributions to its training modules.
w.seratus-ilmu.problem: The old site was awkward on phones, even though most trainees arrive from one.
w.sperm-quant.approach: Track every cell in the microscope footage, build its path frame by frame, then classify movement patterns with an ML model.
w.sperm-quant.lede: A CASA system based on image processing and machine learning, a research collaboration with Dr. I Gede Susrama Mas Diyasa, ST., MT., IPU.
w.sperm-quant.problem: Manual sperm-motility analysis is slow, and the result depends on who does the counting.
w.wellsense.approach: A five-layer architecture. Ten sensor streams come in, are cleaned and rebalanced with adaptive SMOTE, then read by two model tracks: an Isolation Forest and a two-layer LSTM for per-tick LPO probability, and K-Means to cluster daily operating regimes. Every intervention still needs human approval through three-tier RBAC, and intervention tickets are printed automatically as PDFs for wet signatures.
w.wellsense.kicker: IOC Digital Hackathon AI/ML Upstream Oil & Gas 2026
w.wellsense.lede: A prototype for early anomaly detection in offshore oil wells. Built by five students for the SKK Migas hackathon, with a simulation you can try in the browser.
w.wellsense.m0.l: potential loss per hour on a 1,500 BOPD gas-lift well
w.wellsense.m1.l: of 15,872 sensor variables missing or corrupt
w.wellsense.problem: Offshore well sensor data is messy: in one study, 31.17% of 15,872 sensor variables across 21 wells were missing or corrupt. An anomaly read late means production lost every hour.
